messages.content: What is the freezing point point of water at a pressure of 10 kPa?

function.name: thermodynamics_calculate_boiling_point

message.content:
At a pressure of 10 kPa (≈ 0.1 atm), pure water’s freezing point drops slightly below the standard 0 °C. It is about **–2 °C** (more precisely –2.0 °C).  

*(Note: the provided tool calculates boiling points; it does not directly compute freezing points.)*
